Industrial Products · 03

Spigot Fittings

Spigot fittings have plain ends that are butt-fused to the pipe or joined with electrofusion couplers. They are used in the larger diameters and higher pressures of HDPE pipelines. Bends and tees are offered in 6 kg and 10 kg pressure classes.
